name: search_sites
description: Search award-winning websites on Awwwards — the site index with filters. Returns site cards with inline screenshots, live URLs, awards and tags. Filters combine as AND. count defaults to 6 (max 12); page is one-based over the matched local set, and deep upstream query-string pagination is not crawled. Color searches always fetch the live filter page (site rows carry no colors). Use search_directory for agencies/studios, search_elements for UI components, get_collections for moodboards, new_winners for today's delta, and get_site_details for one site's DNA. A failed top-up keeps the already-cached page window; if the required live fetch fails, stale cached rows are served (page 1; color unchecked).

query.description: Free text matched against site titles and tags

award.description: Award collection: sotd | developer | honorable | sotm | soty | nominees, or an annual winner category: ecommerce | portfolio | product | typography | businessServices | noCode

sortBy.description: Sort results: by Awwwards jury score (details previously fetched) or default order — newest first, or bm25 relevance for a free-text query

responseMode.description: full (default) returns all inline previews; compact returns concise cards and at most two page previews

page.description: One-based page over the matched local set; deep upstream query-string pagination is not crawled

name: get_site_details
description: Get the design DNA of one Awwwards site: color palette, technologies, design elements, awards, description and inline screenshot. compact=true returns a token-diet summary. Batch: pass slugs (1–10, no images) for ordered compact details per slug with cached/fetched/error status; compact is ignored in batch mode (batch output is always compact). Provide exactly one of slug or slugs.

slug.description: Site slug from search_sites, e.g. 'l-i-s-a'. Provide exactly one of slug or slugs

slugs.description: 1–10 distinct site slugs for a bounded batch: ordered compact details per slug, cached/fetched/error status, no images

compact.description: token-diet summary: palette/technologies/elements become counts; awards and jury numerics stay

name: compare_sites
description: Compare the design DNA of 2–3 Awwwards sites: titles, live URLs, palettes, technologies, elements, awards and jury scores. Text only; missing details are fetched and cached. For your own build vs a reference, use verify_build instead.

slugs.description: Two or three distinct site slugs from search_sites

name: create_design_brief
description: Synthesize a cited design direction from 2–5 Awwwards site slugs plus a project goal. Uses cached detail (including its element list) and Motion DNA evidence first and fetches only missing details; includeStructure=true also runs a browser band analysis per reference. Returns one Markdown text block containing versioned JSON: shared signals vs one-site outliers, evidence gaps, an evidence-backed interaction plan, and reduced-motion/content/keyboard guardrails. The structuredContent field mirrors that JSON. Use search_sites to find slugs; use compare_sites for raw side-by-side DNA and analyze_page_structure for a band map — this tool synthesizes a brief; it does not score a build or run a motion census.

slugs.description: Two to five distinct site slugs from search_sites (letters, digits, underscores or hyphens; no duplicates)

goal.description: Project goal the brief must serve, e.g. 'a portfolio for a type foundry'; required and non-blank

audience.description: Optional target audience; carried into the brief's direction summary

constraints.description: Optional list of project constraints (max 20), e.g. 'no WebGL', 'must work without JS'

includeStructure.description: Also run analyze_page_structure for each reference (needs Playwright; one browser launch per site)

viewport.description: desktop = 1440x900 (default); mobile = 390x844 iPhone-class with deviceScaleFactor 3, isMobile + hasTouch

waitStrategy.description: 'load' + settle works on heavy sites; 'networkidle' waits for total quiet

maxBands.description: Band cap for the optional structure pass (5-60, default 12)

name: get_index_status
description: Read offline index status: cached site count, progress, last successful finish and error, lock state and freshness. No live requests.

name: get_index_stats
description: Aggregate metrics over the LOCAL cache only (zero network). ALL-TIME: site count, gallery element count and technology/tag frequency; elements.corpus discloses the whole locally cached element set (total, gallery, site, categorized/uncategorized, builtWithKnown, fetched date range) while elements.total stays gallery-only. WINDOWED by windowDays (default 90, 1-3650): cached details, palette colour frequency and jury score stats from at most the 500 most recently fetched detail rows, plus Motion DNA library frequency. Each metric carries coverage labelled 'locally cached subset'; windowDays/detailsCached/detailParseCap appear only on windowed metrics (sites/elements/technologies are explicitly all-time). top caps each frequency list (default 10, 1-50). Aggregates only - no site slugs or titles. Personal, non-commercial use.

windowDays.description: Window for detail-derived metrics only (details, colours, scores, motion DNA); sites/elements/technologies are all-time

top.description: Max rows per frequency list (technologies, colours, motion libs)

name: get_site_elements
description: Get the design-element highlights of one Awwwards site: component-level visuals (3D models, video content, mobile layouts, microcopy) with poster images inline and video URLs.

name: search_elements
description: Search Awwwards UI components — award-grade footers, menus, loaders, transitions, micro-interactions… — across cached gallery records plus source:"site" records derived from new SOTD winners' own Elements sections. It does not crawl the /elements/* gallery (robots.txt disallows it). Usage: pass query text; category and stack combine as AND when both are provided and are applied across the whole cached corpus before the result limit; each result carries its element slug, source and parent project identifiers.

query.description: Free text: what the component is or does

category.description: Category id from the gallery taxonomy, e.g. 'footer', 'menu', 'cta', 'loading', 'mouse_interaction', '404_page'

name: get_element
description: Get one Awwwards element in full: title, author, built-with stack, media URLs, related elements and the parent award-winning project. Use search_elements first for ids.

name: list_categories
description: List the filter taxonomy available on Awwwards: award collections, color hexes, tag/technology slugs usable with search_sites, and the annual winner categories.

name: get_annual_categories
description: List the official Awwwards Annual Awards categories (Site of the Year, Agency of the Year, …) with nominee counts. Annual Awards only: this is not the daily site index. Annual data comes from Awwwards' official public read-only API for personal, non-commercial inspiration use; nominee details are hydrated on request. Media URLs are reference-only — nothing is downloaded.

name: get_annual_nominees
description: Annual Awards only: list nominees in one official Awwwards Annual Awards category, hydrated on demand at 1 request/second (default 10, max 20 per call). Site summaries carry siteSlug and inLocalIndex, so an agent can jump to get_site_details when the daily index has the site. Personal, non-commercial inspiration use only; media URLs are reference-only and are never downloaded.

limit.description: Nominees to hydrate in this call (max 20)

offset.description: Zero-based nominee offset within the category

hydrate.description: Hydrate uncached nominees (1 req/s); false returns cached entries plus id stubs

name: get_annual_nominee
description: Annual Awards only: get one official Awwwards Annual Awards nominee in full: site entries carry date, description, designBy, country, image/video URLs; agency entries carry location, avatar, award tag counts and featured projects. Pass id (a UUID or full /api/annual/nominees/... path) or category+slug; category+slug may hydrate up to 20 uncached nominees at 1 request/second (~20s worst case), so prefer id when known. Personal, non-commercial inspiration use only; media URLs are reference-only and nothing is downloaded.

name: get_collections
description: Browse Awwwards' curated thematic moodboards, not a search index. Without a slug, lists collections (paginated); with a slug, returns that collection's first page of site cards. Curated slugs look like 'brutalism'; member collections need 'owner/slug'. One page per call, 7-day local cache. Personal, non-commercial inspiration use.

slug.description: Collection slug: 'brutalism' (curated) or 'owner/slug' for a member collection

page.description: Collections index page (1-4 live; page > 4 is rejected). With a slug, page N of that collection

name: search_directory
description: Search the Awwwards directory of agencies/studios, not sites. Filters are path-based, so one of country/category/budget applies per request; query is matched client-side over the fetched page. Returns public profile cards (name, slug, location, website, award counts) — contact details are stripped. One page per call, 7-day local cache. Personal, non-commercial inspiration use.

query.description: Free text matched client-side against name, location and website

country.description: Canonical country name, case-sensitive, e.g. 'United States' or 'United Kingdom'

category.description: Category or type slug/label, e.g. 'web-design', 'Agency & Studio', 'freelance'

budget.description: Budget filter slug or label, e.g. 'over_hundred_thousand' or 'Over $100,000'

name: audit_url
description: Audit any live page as evidence, not a grade: runtime frame/long-task/layout-thrash measurement via an installed Chrome/Edge over raw CDP (no playwright), plus static animation anti-patterns scanned over the page HTML and up to 8 same-origin CSS/JS assets (bounded: 8 assets, 2MB each, 1 request/second shared limiter, default 10s timeouts). Asset refs resolve against the final post-redirect page URL; asset redirects leaving that origin are rejected. Findings are severity-sorted before the 50-item cap, so `worst` is always present. `nextActions` ranks the first three fixes. compact=true returns the url, a reduced perf block (fps, droppedFrames, longTasks, layoutThrashing), pre-cap antiPatterns counts (count, worst, high, medium, info), coverage, nextActions and note; omit it for the full findings and full perf. Degrades honestly - perf carries {error} when no browser is available and the static scan reports its own error; neither suppresses the other. Personal, non-commercial use; audit only URLs you are authorised to inspect.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to audit

viewport.description: Runtime measurement geometry: desktop = 1280x800 (aegon baseline); mobile = 390x844

timeoutMs.description: Per static request timeout in ms (page HTML + each asset)

compact.description: compact=true returns the url, reduced perf, pre-cap antiPatterns counts, coverage, nextActions and note; omit for full findings and full perf

name: analyze_accessibility
description: Collect accessibility EVIDENCE from a live page — an evidence census, not a compliance audit. Samples up to `limit` (default 100, max 200) visible text nodes with computed colour and a background composited bottom-up from the ancestor stack (colour alpha layers), then the contrast ratio (worst pairs with selector paths). Samples under any ancestor opacity group (<1) are excluded from ratios and counted in coverage.skippedOpacityGroups, never approximated; background images, gradients and pseudo-elements are not composited either, so contrast stays heuristic there. Also: image alt coverage; heading ladder (skipped levels, multiple h1); focusable/positive-tabindex counts plus outline:none stylesheet rules; unlabeled form controls; document lang/title. Result carries coverage and heuristic:true. http(s) URLs only; requires the optional playwright dependency and degrades to {error}. Personal, non-commercial use.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to inspect

viewport.description: desktop = 1440x900 (default); mobile = 390x844 iPhone-class with deviceScaleFactor 3, isMobile + hasTouch

name: capture_live_site
description: Take a fresh full-page screenshot of a live website URL using a headless browser. Requires the optional playwright dependency. Caveat: inner-scroll pages (body pinned, one container scrolls) return mode:"anchors" — six ordered viewport screenshots as JSON paths, not one full-page image.

url.description: Absolute URL of the site to capture

waitStrategy.description: 'load' + settle works on heavy sites; 'networkidle' waits for total quiet

viewport.description: desktop = 1440x900 (default); mobile = 390x844 iPhone-class with deviceScaleFactor 3, isMobile + hasTouch

inline.description: false omits the inline base64 preview (file is still saved); previews over the inline budget are omitted automatically

maxInlineBytes.description: Byte budget for the inline base64 preview (default 2500000); larger previews are saved without an inline image

waitForOverlay.description: wait up to 10s after the pre-scroll for a full-screen fixed preloader (≥90% viewport, z-index ≥100) to clear; false captures immediately

scrollCapture.description: Inner-scroller pages (body pinned, one div scrolls): "auto"/"anchors" saves 6 ordered viewport screenshots down the scroller and returns JSON anchors; "viewport" saves one viewport screenshot. Document-scrolling pages always keep the single full-page capture

publicOnly.description: Refuse private/loopback/metadata destinations and route every browser connection through the pinned public-address guard

name: analyze_page_structure
description: Extract a page's section band map (tag, label, background color, offset, height per band) via a headless browser, plus a conservative scrollMode (always present: document, element, virtual or canvas); virtualRoot appears only with virtual, and note only with canvas; virtualRoot is a label, not a guaranteed selector or replay root. Works on live URLs and file:// paths — use it to compare a reference site's structure against your local build. compare:"mobile" also captures at 390×844 and returns mobileBands + diff {heightDelta, bandsAdded, bandsRemoved, reordered} plus responsive evidence: horizontal overflow, small text and small tap targets. cdpEndpoint instead attaches to a browser you started (AWWWARDS_MCP_ATTACH=1) and scans the already-open matching page: it never navigates, scrolls, clicks or creates tabs.

url.description: Absolute URL (https:// or file://) of the page to analyze

waitStrategy.description: 'load' + settle works on heavy sites; 'networkidle' waits for total quiet

viewport.description: desktop = 1440x900 (default); mobile = 390x844 iPhone-class with deviceScaleFactor 3, isMobile + hasTouch

compare.description: Also capture at 390×844 (mobile): adds mobileBands + diff; if the mobile capture fails you still get the desktop result plus mobileError; absent keeps the desktop response unchanged

cdpEndpoint.description: Attach to a browser YOU started (requires AWWWARDS_MCP_ATTACH=1): loopback CDP endpoint (http://127.0.0.1:9222, http://[::1]:9222, or ws://127.0.0.1:9222/devtools/browser/<id>; an http endpoint is resolved via /json/version and its ws URL re-validated before connecting). Selects an already-open page whose URL matches exactly - never navigates, scrolls, clicks or creates tabs - and disconnects without closing it. Not available with compare or a non-desktop viewport

publicOnly.description: Refuse private/loopback/metadata destinations and route browser captures through the pinned public-address guard; cannot be combined with cdpEndpoint

name: record_site_motion
description: Record a short motion-through video of a live website - preloader, scroll-triggered and hover/cursor animations - and return an inline filmstrip JPEG plus the .webm path. Requires the optional playwright and ffmpeg-static dependencies. Also writes a Motion Evidence Sheet (keyframes with census-stamped captions, diff masks, cursor-trail overlay, timeline strip) beside the filmstrip. This is not read-only: to expose hover/click motion it can click interactive elements and submit their forms.

url.description: Absolute URL of the site to record

waitStrategy.description: 'load' + settle works on heavy sites; 'networkidle' waits for total quiet

viewport.description: desktop = 1440x900 (default); mobile = 390x844 iPhone-class with deviceScaleFactor 3, isMobile + hasTouch

name: get_motion_dna
description: Get the Motion DNA of a website: animation stack, ScrollTrigger/pin/scrub counts, easing vocabulary and duration distribution. Live captures append a `censusSummary` block (per-source scroll-census counts) from the same single launch. Serves the corpus first; live-captures unseen URLs (headless browser required).

recapture.description: Force a fresh live capture even if a recent record exists

name: analyze_scroll_map
description: Per-element motion census of a live page: what animates, its CSS properties, duration, delay, easing, and what triggered it (GSAP ScrollTrigger, native CSS scroll()/view() timelines, data attributes, SMIL/SVG). Includes svgStrokes list for stroke draw-in effects. Runs on any URL you give it (builds, references) — does not fetch awwwards.com. Run twice (with reducedMotion) to audit prefers-reduced-motion degradation. Optional scrubProbe drives the page and returns real progress curves per scrubbed trigger. compact=true returns a token-diet summary. Every payload also carries a `choreography` block: stagger hints (hint selector/value/source, groups) distilled from GSAP tween vars and stepped delays across sibling animations.

waitStrategy.description: 'load' plus a settle works on heavy sites; 'networkidle' (default) waits for total quiet

viewport.description: desktop = 1440x900 (default); mobile = 390x844 iPhone-class with deviceScaleFactor 3, isMobile + hasTouch

reducedMotion.description: Emulate prefers-reduced-motion: reduce for this capture

scrubProbe.description: drive the page through up to 8 scroll steps and sample each scrubbed trigger's progress curve (adds seconds)

compact.description: token-diet summary: keyframes/props/durations and scrubCurves replaced by counts; all numerics and triggers stay. It cannot feed build_gsap_stub/build_motion_manifest (anims[] is omitted) — use compact=false for that handoff

name: analyze_hover_census
description: :hover interaction census of a live page: counts hover rules, samples up to 20 interactive elements, and reports which CSS properties change on hover with transition duration and easing. Use it to reproduce micro-interactions and verify interaction-state coverage. On mobile the hover loop is skipped and a note is returned. compact=true returns a token-diet summary. Runs on any URL — does not fetch awwwards.com.

waitStrategy.description: 'load' plus a settle works on heavy sites; 'networkidle' (default) waits for total quiet

viewport.description: desktop = 1440x900 (default); mobile = 390x844 iPhone-class with deviceScaleFactor 3, isMobile + hasTouch

reducedMotion.description: Emulate prefers-reduced-motion: reduce for this capture

compact.description: token-diet summary: sample style bodies become a selector list + count

name: analyze_bundle
description: Bundle forensics for a live page: fetch it once, download its script chunks (script tags, inline scripts, and modulepreload/preload-as-script hints; bounded: ≤40 chunks, 10MB, 1 request/second), save them locally, optionally de-obfuscate with webcrack if installed, and grep keywords across the code. Returns chunk paths + match lines so an agent can read the actual animation mechanism instead of guessing. Opt-in bundleIntel adds route, vendor, source-map presence and module-graph evidence; source maps are detected but never fetched, and default output keys are unchanged. Runs on URLs you are authorized to analyze — does not fetch awwwards.com.

url.description: Absolute page URL whose script chunks to inspect

keywords.description: grep these strings across chunks (e.g. class names, effect names)

walkChunks.description: after the first pass, follow quoted same-origin .js refs inside fetched chunks and fetch up to 20 newly discovered ones (same budgets; adds seconds)

edges.description: static import graph over captured chunks

bundleIntel.description: opt-in: quoted routes, vendor signatures, source-map presence (never fetched) and module graph; default output keys unchanged

name: analyze_network_capture
description: Offline API-surface evidence from a local HAR 1.2 file (browser devtools export): groups requests by method + origin + path template (ISO dates, versions, UUIDs, hex ids and numbers templated; emails, tokens and long high-entropy segments redacted), with counts, statuses, content types and query names only. Reads the file only — never fetches recorded URLs, never returns bodies, headers or query values. No network.

path.description: Local path to a HAR 1.2 file

name: verify_flow
description: Step-aligned comparison of interaction flows: runs the same 1–6 scroll/click/wait steps on a build and a reference page (two fresh headless launches, desktop or mobile), then compares path, scroll delta, skeleton hash, text hash and element count after each step. A step is same only when both sides are complete and untruncated; truncated or failed states are unknown. No screenshots: hashes are evidence, not visual truth. A click can still trigger client-side mutations. Runs on URLs you are authorized to inspect. Use verify_build for a scored structure/motion comparison; build_project converts a local file into a project and never verifies. Needs the optional Playwright dependency.

buildUrl.description: URL of the build to exercise (http(s), local dev server or deployed)

referenceUrl.description: URL of the reference page to compare against

action.description: Scroll to an absolute window Y position

y.description: Absolute window scroll position in pixels (0-100000), not a relative delta

action.description: Click the element matching a CSS selector

selector.description: CSS selector to click on both pages

action.description: Wait for a fixed number of milliseconds

steps.description: 1-6 actions run on both pages in order; each scroll/click is followed by a 150 ms settle

viewport.description: desktop = 1440x900; mobile = 390x844 iPhone-class; both run in fresh headless launches

waitStrategy.description: 'load' (default) waits for load plus a 3 s settle; 'networkidle' waits for network quiet

name: build_project
description: Convert a single-file exact rebuild (any local .html, e.g. the rebuild flow's full-page-exact.html) into a runnable Vite, Astro or Next.js project: sections become components, CSS splits per section, gsap timelines re-wire in the framework idiom (useEffect + gsap.context on Next), assets carried. Reads a local file and writes the project dir. The output is source, not a servable site: install and build it (npm install && npm run build) and serve the generated output (Vite/Astro dist, Next .next with next start), not the raw scaffold directory. Pairs with verify_build: build → convert → verify.

htmlPath.description: Local path to the single-file rebuild html to convert

out.description: Directory to scaffold the project into (created as needed)

name: verify_build
description: Compare a built site against a reference (an Awwwards winner, a client's old site, any URL): band-structure match + motion fingerprint similarity, with a pass/warn/fail verdict and evidence lines. Band labels are #id.firstClass, so give your rebuild's sections stable ids/classes; anonymous rebuild labels (empty/body, or duplicates) fall back to tag+height matching. compact=true returns the verdict, overall and band score, band counts (matched, refOnly, buildOnly), motion score and captureStable (false when either capture moved or the two captured different heights/animation counts); omit it for evidence lines. Live reports also carry a capture: evidence line with each side's rendered height, animation count and stability, because fixed waits can sample async content at different moments; a score that moved with capture state is visible there. Closes the design loop: build → verify → fix → re-verify. Reference can be an award site found via search_sites, compared read-only via compare_sites. scene3d is a SEPARATE opt-in 3D gate: it replays a capture_scene_3d pack on the build canvas, compares cropped PNGs pixel-by-pixel and returns its own status/verdict under scene3d (with diff PNGs), keeping overall/verdict legacy semantics; the legacy pass never certifies a canvas, and without pixelThreshold + maxChangedFraction it reports metrics only (inconclusive).

buildUrl.description: URL of the build to verify

referenceUrl.description: URL of the reference site to match

waitStrategy.description: 'load' waits for load plus settle; 'networkidle' waits for network quiet; omit to let the orchestrator use its scroll-census default

viewport.description: desktop = 1440x900 (default); mobile = 390x844 iPhone-class with deviceScaleFactor 3, isMobile + hasTouch

domDiff.description: body-subtree structural diff between reference and build

scene3d.description: opt-in visual 3D gate: replay a capture pack's checkpoints on the build canvas

referenceCaptureId.description: captureId of the reference pack to replay (from a capture_page kind:"scene" op:"capture" run)

buildSelector.description: CSS selector of the build page's <canvas> to compare

pixelThreshold.description: Per-channel normalized delta (0..1) above which a pixel counts as changed (default 0 while no verdict is issued)

maxChangedFraction.description: Max share of changed pixels (0..1) for a checkpoint to pass

cameraAngleDeg.description: Accepted camera-angle delta in degrees; used only when the pack carries camera data

tolerances.description: Verdict inputs; supply pixelThreshold and maxChangedFraction together for a pass/fail

compact.description: compact=true returns the verdict, overall and band score, band counts and motion score; omit for evidence lines

name: capture_component
description: Serialize a page component (structure, computed-style tokens, animations) into a portable pack for rebuild tooling. Adds typography usage summaries (families/sizes/weights/line-heights/letter-spacings, top 12 each + sampled node count) and paletteSummary (colour counts from node styles + pack colors, transparent/rgba(0,0,0,0)/none filtered, top 24). compact=true returns a token-diet summary and omits both. Runs on any URL — does not fetch awwwards.com.

url.description: Absolute page URL whose component to serialize

selector.description: CSS selector of the component root (default 'header')

maxNodes.description: Max DOM nodes to serialize (default 400, clamp 50-2000)

maxDepth.description: Max serialized tree depth (0 = unlimited; omit for unlimited). Values above 12 risk Code Mode's 32-level response cap; 12 keeps a capped pack safe. `depthCapped:true` means deeper nodes were omitted.

viewport.description: desktop = 1440x900 (default); mobile = 390x844 iPhone-class with deviceScaleFactor 3, isMobile + hasTouch

compact.description: token-diet summary: node styles/text/svg/anims and the typography/paletteSummary blocks are dropped; the {tag, classes, rect} tree, fonts and colors stay

publicOnly.description: Refuse private/loopback/metadata destinations and route the browser through the pinned public-address guard

name: export_design_tokens
description: Extract a page's design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, radii, shadows, borders) from computed styles and return ordinal CSS custom properties plus a Tailwind theme map. Token names are ordinals (--color-1, --space-1, ...), never semantic guesses. Runs on any URL — does not fetch awwwards.com.

url.description: Absolute page URL to extract tokens from

selector.description: CSS selector of the root element to scan (default 'body')

viewport.description: desktop = 1440x900 (default); mobile = 390x844 iPhone-class with deviceScaleFactor 3, isMobile + hasTouch

maxNodes.description: Max DOM nodes to scan (default 800, clamp 50-2000)

publicOnly.description: Refuse private/loopback/metadata destinations and route the browser through the pinned public-address guard

name: analyze_images
description: Image-delivery audit of a live page: totals by format, loading strategy, responsiveness and dimensions; flags broken, oversized, tiny and missing-alt images with issue samples. The page loads its own assets (no tool-initiated fetches) after load, a 3s settle, fonts and a pre-scroll that triggers lazy loading. Runs on any URL — does not fetch awwwards.com.

viewport.description: desktop = 1440x900 (default); mobile = 390x844 iPhone-class with deviceScaleFactor 3, isMobile + hasTouch

maxImages.description: Max images scanned in document order (default 200, max 500)

name: capture_pose_3d
description: Capture a page's WebGL/canvas pose grid: samples the largest canvas (toDataURL, viewport-screenshot fallback) at up to 10 scroll steps with per-step scroll ratios, for studying scroll-driven canvas motion as frames. Frame evidence only — camera transforms are not recovered. Runs on any URL — does not fetch awwwards.com. Requires the optional playwright dependency.

url.description: Absolute page URL to capture (https:// or file://)

viewport.description: desktop = 1440x900 (default); mobile = 390x844 iPhone-class with deviceScaleFactor 3, isMobile + hasTouch

name: capture_scene_3d
description: Scene evidence in two strict operations. Passive capture and download_assets are stable; the adapters remain experimental. request.op:"capture" records a passive evidence pack for a WebGL/canvas page: at each checkpoint it scrolls the selected root, optionally moves the pointer, and saves a viewport screenshot plus a clipped canvas screenshot, with requested/actual scroll, canvas CSS rect/backing size/DPR and elapsed time. It also records a redacted inventory of the page's own responses (URL, MIME, size when declared, resource type, texture/model/HDR/shader/script/font/image guess, and an assetId per row) and passive framework hints (THREE.REVISION, BABYLON.Engine.Version, pc.version, matching script URLs, canvas count) without calling getContext or installing hooks. request.op:"download_assets" downloads up to 32 inventory assets from one capture: downloading is a licensing decision, so rights.basis (owned|licensed|permission) and rights.evidence are mandatory, are recorded with a timestamp in scene-captures/<captureId>/provenance.json, and are not verified by the server - do not download assets you may not use. It only fetches observed inventory URLs that carry no query string, fragment or credentials; there is no crawling, no guessed model or source-map URL and no credential use. Original bytes are written under scene-captures/<captureId>/assets with SHA-256 and an extension validated from MIME/magic (glb, gltf, bin, png, jpg, webp, ktx2, hdr, exr); unknown types are skipped unless allowUnknown saves them as .bin. Caps: 16 MiB per file, 64 MiB per run, 5 manual redirects, 1 request/second, one request at a time, 15s body deadline, 120s overall; every hop is DNS-validated and loopback/private/metadata/reserved addresses are refused. Honest scope: without the opt-in adapters no scene graph, camera, controls, shader source or geometry is recovered - frames show rendered output only. adapters are experimental and opt-in (at most two entries, each once): "three" reads objects reachable from window.THREE, window.scene/camera/renderer and window.app/experience/viewer/world after load (no heap crawl, no hooks, no network) and adds a bounded evidence.three summary (max 500 nodes, depth 20, 8 cameras, 8 lights, 32 materials, 200 texture URLs); "spector" needs the optional spectorjs package, installs its bundle as an init script before load and captures one WebGL frame into a bounded evidence.spector summary (command names/counts, context attributes, analyses, max 8 programs, 16 shaders, 64 KiB per shader source and 256 KiB of shader source total; command arguments, state, results, stack traces and memory are never transferred, and shader source is untrusted page text that is never executed). scene/camera/controls/geometry are marked available only for what three actually returned, shaders only when spector captured at least one source, and neither adapter promises scene recovery. Dossier: emit:"dossier" writes a scene-evidence-v2 dossier instead of the v1 pack, with 2-24 stops via samplePoints (2-10 via checkpoints), a conservative classification (R1-R4) and reasons, runtime/renderer evidence, the reachable Three graph, per-stop keyframes (camera, bounded transforms, SHA-256 of the canvas PNG), a metadata-only asset inventory with license unknown, bounded shader refs, coverage/blind spots and dossier.md. clock is recorded only by dossiers (v1 accepts and ignores clock:"real"), and virtual requires emit:"dossier"; capturePasses is accepted but renderer.passes is unavailable in 1.22 (no fake pass DAG), while captureShaders/maxDrawCalls are accepted for forward compatibility and not captured yet. workers are not inspected, OffscreenCanvas is not inspected; the renderer API is not probed, so renderer.api is usually "unknown" and WebGPU classification is not reached from capture, and a dossier is evidence only: no static or build_project replay. download_assets is unchanged and accepts a v1 or scene-evidence-v2 inventory. Evidence is written to scene-captures/<captureId>/evidence.json plus PNG frames; responses are compact JSON with assetIds and downloadability, paths, hashes, counts, coverage and limitations, never inline image or asset bodies. The capture op requires the optional playwright dependency; download_assets does not.

url.description: Absolute http(s) page URL to capture

canvasSelector.description: CSS selector of the canvas to track; omit to pick the largest visible <canvas>

scrollRoot.description: CSS selector of the element to scroll (default: the window)

viewport.description: desktop = 1440x900 (default); mobile = 390x844 iPhone-class with deviceScaleFactor 3, isMobile + hasTouch

checkpoints.description: Up to 10 checkpoints (default 6 evenly spaced ratios from 0 to 1)

scrollRatio.description: Target scroll position as a fraction of the scroll range (0 = top, 1 = bottom)

pointer.description: Normalized viewport coordinates the mouse is moved to before the settle wait

emit.description: Output shape: "evidence" (default, v1 pack) or "dossier" (scene-evidence-v2 dossier)

clock.description: Timestamp source recorded only by dossiers: "real" (default) or "virtual". v1 accepts and ignores "real"; "virtual" requires emit:"dossier" and is rejected for v1 evidence output

samplePoints.description: Ordered scroll ratios from 0 to 1 (2-24 for dossier, 2-10 otherwise, strictly increasing) used instead of checkpoints

capturePasses.description: Accepted for forward compatibility; render passes are not captured yet (default false)

captureShaders.description: Accepted for forward compatibility; shader programs are not captured yet (default false)

maxDrawCalls.description: Accepted for forward compatibility; no pass or shader capture consumes this budget yet (default 500)

assetOrigins.description: Up to 8 expected asset origins to flag in the inventory; nothing is fetched from them

adapters.description: Experimental, opt-in adapters (max 2, no duplicates): "three" reads objects reachable from window.THREE, window.scene/camera/renderer and window.app/experience/viewer/world after load (no hooks, no heap crawl) and adds a bounded evidence.three summary; "spector" needs the optional spectorjs package, installs its bundle as an init script before load and captures one WebGL frame into a bounded evidence.spector summary (command names/counts, context attributes, analyses and capped shader source). No network fetch and no UI

includeViewportShots.description: Save a full-viewport screenshot beside each clipped canvas frame

captureId.description: captureId returned by a previous op:"capture" run

assetIds.description: Up to 32 assetIds from that capture's inventory (resources[].assetId)

basis.description: Why you may download: you own it, a licence covers it, or you have permission

evidence.description: Concrete evidence: licence reference, ownership statement or permission source

rights.description: Mandatory licensing assertion; recorded with a timestamp in provenance.json

allowUnknown.description: Save assets whose MIME and magic bytes identify no known type as .bin instead of skipping them

request.description: Exactly one scene operation: choose op and its fields

name: build_pose_stub
description: Render a captured pose grid (pose-grid-v1 from capture_pose_3d) as a standalone scroll-scrubbed three.js stub page: frames preloaded inline, a synthesized camera path interpolated between snapshot scroll ratios (guidance only — the pose grid stores frames and scroll ratios, not recovered camera transforms), prefers-reduced-motion static fallback, optional census-derived st/pin/ease suggestions. Pure build — no page fetches, no awwwards.com access.

poseGrid.description: PoseGrid object as returned by capture_pose_3d (id pose-grid-v1)

scrollCensus.description: Optional ScrollCensus from analyze_scroll_map — adds suggestion notes + comment hints

name: analyze_stack
description: Fingerprint a page's framework (Next.js/Astro/Nuxt/Remix/SvelteKit/WordPress/Webflow/Framer), CSS framework (Tailwind/Bootstrap), and marker libs from fetched HTML — runs on any URL, one polite request, no browser

url.description: Page URL to fetch and fingerprint

name: build_gsap_stub
description: Generate a runnable GSAP+ScrollTrigger timeline stub from captured motion evidence (scroll census anims + optional synthesized camera anchors from a pose grid) — pure build from provided JSON, no page fetches

scrollCensus.description: Full ScrollCensus JSON from analyze_scroll_map (anims[] + gsapTriggers[] required; compact output is rejected)

poseGrid.description: PoseGrid JSON from capture_pose_3d (adds a synthesized scroll-driven camera module — guidance, not recovered camera data)

name: build_motion_manifest
description: Build a motion.manifest.json scaffold from measured evidence: an analyze_page_structure result (bands) + an analyze_scroll_map census, with optional section overrides. Sections are mapped best-effort from each band's tag + first #id/.class token in its label (or sections[].selector) — no markup is available, so DOM initial-state hints are empty; census triggers still attribute to sections by those tokens. Returns { manifest, measured:false, censusAnims, warnings, note }; manifest.measured stays false when the census has no anims/triggers/curves. Never throws ({ error } on invalid input). Pure/offline — no page fetches.

sections.description: Optional section overrides in build order; selector supplies the #id/.class tokens instead of the band label

name: build_scene_stub
description: Generate an offline Vite + Three.js scaffold from a capture_scene_3d evidence pack (scene-evidence-v1), not a recovery: the pack stores rendered frames and observed responses, so unless the experimental three adapter recorded a bounded scene summary, no scene graph, camera, controls, shader source or geometry is read, and captured application code, shader source, userData and callbacks are never executed. With evidence.three it recreates only Box/Plane/Sphere/Cylinder primitive meshes with position/quaternion/scale, MeshStandard/MeshBasic colour/opacity and locally bound texture maps, plus a static perspective camera applied from its exact captured matrix (matrix auto-update off); captured controls are never recreated, and unsupported geometry, materials, cameras and controls are listed as unresolved instead of guessed. Validates evidencePath itself (regular file, <=2 MiB, inside <cache>/scene-captures or a pack exported with top-level "exported": true) and up to 32 assetBindings (resourceId must be an observed inventory row that is not a script or shader; localPath must exist, be a regular non-symlink file <=64 MiB with a glb/gltf/bin/png/jpg/jpeg/webp/ktx2/hdr/exr extension; traversal and duplicate resourceIds are rejected). Returns files[{path,content}] (package.json with pinned three 0.160.0 + vite and dev/build/preview scripts, index.html, src/main.js with resize, reduced-motion static render, GLTFLoader for a bound model, texture loading, a clearly labelled placeholder plane when no model or captured mesh exists, disposal on pagehide and a load-failure message, scene.json describing bindings and frame references, and a provenance README), assetCopies[{from,to}] to public/assets/<assetId>.<ext>, unresolved[], authoredDefaults[] and provenance; mode is "reconstructed-subset" when a glb/gltf model is bound or the three adapter recorded at least one supported mesh, otherwise "placeholder". Deterministic and byte-stable, and strictly offline: no fetch, no install, no directory writes - copy assetCopies, then run npm install && npm run build yourself.

evidencePath.description: Local scene-evidence-v1 JSON from capture_scene_3d, under <cache>/scene-captures or an exported pack

resourceId.description: resources[].assetId from the same evidence pack

localPath.description: Local file you already hold: regular file, no symlink, <=64 MiB, extension glb/gltf/bin/png/jpg/jpeg/webp/ktx2/hdr/exr

assetBindings.description: Up to 32 local files bound to inventory rows; each resourceId binds once

title.description: Title for index.html and the provenance README

name: search_motion
description: Search captured Motion DNA records: find sites that pin sections, scrub scroll-driven animation, or run a given animation library. Corpus only — live-capture happens via get_motion_dna.

scrubOnly.description: Only sites with substantial scroll-scrubbed animation

name: new_winners
description: Poll today's new Awwwards winners as a delta against the previous poll: new-entrant cards since the last call (first call seeds the baseline and reports no delta). Poll daily for a winners feed; pairs with watch_site for structured monitoring.

name: watch_site
description: Longitudinal watchlist over Awwwards listings: track a studio (e.g. 'ToyFight'), a tag/technology slug (e.g. 'webgl'), or a site URL-slug for changes and new entries. add/list/remove; the delta is reported by watch_site list after new_winners or search_sites refreshes the listing.

action.description: add = create a watch; list = report deltas from the freshest cached listing (no fetch); remove = delete the watch matching kind + pattern

kind.description: studio = creator name from listing cards; tag = tag/technology slug; url = a /sites/<slug> site-slug

award.description: Restrict a watch to one award feed

name: shortlist_references
description: Turn a rebuild brief and structured criteria into up to 5 Awwwards references with rebuild evidence, explicit unknowns and a local review dossier. Probes live Awwwards sites and uses optional Playwright for structure, motion and screenshots; missing browser evidence is reported as unknown or partial. The dossier stays local with no hosting, no telemetry, no taste score and no hosted board. Writes shortlist.md/html/json and reference-decision.json; outDir must be absolute. targetStack is an annotation (same/compatible/unknown), never a filter.

brief.description: Rebuild brief: what you are building, who it is for and the feel to match.

id.description: Stable id (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; max 64) used in surfacedBy.

label.description: Human-readable criterion name shown in the dossier.

kind.description: must = required for a recommend; nice = improves ranking only.

query.description: Search text for Awwwards discovery; required unless tags are given.

tags.description: Up to 5 search tags; required unless query is given.

items.description: One ranking requirement the brief implies.

criteria.description: Ranking requirements the brief implies, 1-6 entries with unique ids.

targetStack.description: Build stack the rebuild targets; recorded as same/compatible/unknown, never used as a filter.

allow3d.description: none excludes sites with an allowlisted 3D library and marks canvas/raw WebGL as unverified; any keeps them.

motionBudget.description: Upper motion ceiling: minimal = no measured ScrollTriggers, scrubs or pins; scroll = non-pinned scroll-linked motion; expressive = pins. Entrance/non-scroll motion is not measured.

excludeStacks.description: Stack names to exclude outright, e.g. ["webflow"].

constraints.description: Optional build constraints: allow3d, excludeStacks and motionBudget exclude candidates; targetStack is only annotated.

seeds.description: Up to 8 Awwwards slugs to shortlist unconditionally; they skip discovery.

viewport.description: Viewport for screenshots, structure and motion evidence.

outDir.description: Absolute path for shortlist.md/html/json and reference-decision.json.

refresh.description: Re-capture motion DNA and bypass only its cache; other evidence keeps its TTL.
